cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Busy Doing.

words.en: Please add some salt to the soup.
words.scene: Mum pouring salt from a small blue shaker into a steaming bowl of vegetable soup on the kitchen table.
more: Add two eggs to the cake mix.
在蛋糕糊里加两个鸡蛋。
Can you add this book to my list?
你能把这本书加到我的清单上吗？

words.en: The film begins at seven o'clock.
words.scene: A cinema screen glowing bright blue as the lights go down, Lily and Tom sitting in red seats holding popcorn buckets.
more: 我们现在开始做作业吧。

words.en: Sam builds a tall house with blocks.
words.sz: Sam 用积木搭了一座高房子。
words.scene: Sam carefully placing a red block on top of a very high tower made of colourful wooden blocks on the living room rug.
more: We build big houses at the beach.
我们在海滩上堆大房子。
Dad helps me build my bike shed.

words.scene: A family gathered around a table with a chocolate cake and lit candles, Grandma smiling happily with a party hat on.
more: 让我们庆祝我们的胜利！

words.scene: Lily putting her pencil down on a notebook, looking relieved and smiling, with Max sleeping at her feet.
more: Tom cannot complete the puzzle alone.
Tom 一个人拼不完这个拼图。

words.scene: Tom sitting in a beanbag chair, looking at an open picture book, pointing at a page as if telling a story.
more: Let's continue our game after lunch.
让我们午饭后继续玩游戏。

words.en: Copy these words into your book.
words.sz: 把这些单词抄写到你的本子里。
words.scene: Lily writing neatly in a lined exercise book with a blue pen, looking at a worksheet on the desk.
more: Tom copies the picture from the book.
Tom 照着书上的图画画。

words.en: Cover the bowl with a plate.
words.scene: A silver saucepan on a stove, Mum placing a glass lid with a black handle on top of it.
more: Snow covers the garden in winter.
The book has a blue cover.
这本书有一个蓝色的封面。

words.en: Lily designs a new card for Mum.
words.sz: Lily 给妈妈设计了一张新卡片。
words.scene: Lily drawing flowers and stars on a white piece of paper with coloured pencils, scissors and glue nearby.
more: Mia likes the design on her T-shirt.
Mia 喜欢她T恤上的图案。

words.sz: Tom 发现了一只小甲虫。
words.scene: Tom crouching in the grass, looking closely at a shiny green beetle on a leaf with big curious eyes.
more: We discovered a new park near our house.
我们在房子附近发现了一个新公园。
Did you discover anything in the box?
你在盒子里发现了什么吗？

words.en: We explore the forest with Dad.
words.sz: 我们和爸爸一起探索森林。
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Dad walking on a path in a green forest, looking at tall trees and ferns.
more: Max loves to explore the garden.
Max 喜欢在花园里到处逛。
让我们探索那座老房子吧。

words.en: Tom does not fail his test.
more: I tried hard but I failed the game.
我很努力但还是输掉了比赛。
Don't be afraid to fail sometimes.

words.en: Fill the glass with orange juice.
words.scene: Mum pouring bright orange juice from a jug into a clear glass on the breakfast table.
more: Tom fills his bag with toys.
Tom 用玩具装满他的书包。
Please fill in your name here.
请在这里填写你的名字。

words.scene: Lily looking at a worksheet with blank lines, holding a pencil and thinking carefully.
more: Can you fill in this form?
Fill in the spaces with 'a' or 'the'.

words.scene: Lily pushing an empty plate away, wiping her mouth with a napkin, looking at the clock on the wall.
more: The match finishes at five o'clock.

words.sz: 爸爸修好了我的自行车。
words.scene: Dad kneeling next to a blue bicycle, using a screwdriver on the chain, Lily watching him.
more: Mum can fix the broken toy car.
妈妈能修好坏掉的玩具车。
Can you help me fix this shelf?
你能帮我修这个架子吗？

words.sz: Lily 提高了她的写作水平。
words.scene: Lily comparing two pages in a notebook, one with messy letters and one with neat, straight letters.
more: Practice helps us improve our English.
练习帮助我们提高英语水平。
Tom wants to improve his football game.
Tom 想提高他的足球比赛表现。
My bag includes books and pens.

words.sz: Sam 发明了一个新游戏。
words.scene: Sam standing in the garden holding a strange contraption made of cardboard boxes and string, looking proud.
more: People invent many things every day.
人们每天发明很多东西。

words.en: The phone is a great invention.
words.sz: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.scene: A simple drawing of a glowing yellow light bulb inside a circle, surrounded by stars and question marks.
more: This machine is a clever invention.
这台机器是一个聪明的发明。
你最喜欢的发明是什么？

words.scene: Lily handing a birthday party card to Mia at the school gate, both smiling.
Tom holding a fancy card with gold stars, looking happy and surprised, standing by the front door.
more: 这张邀请函是粉红色的。

words.scene: Dad in an apron standing at a kitchen counter, using two large spoons to toss green leaves and red tomatoes in a big bowl.
Mum folding clothes neatly into an open suitcase on the bed, a few items still waiting on the chair.
Lily standing on a small stage with a microphone, singing happily to an audience of classmates and teachers.
The family sitting around the living room table, Dad pointing at a map while Mum writes in a notebook.
Mum in the kitchen washing vegetables and cutting carrots, a pot boiling on the stove behind her.
Dad standing next to a printer on a desk, taking a fresh color photograph out of the tray.
Lily wearing headphones and holding a microphone, singing into it while looking at a music stand.
more: Dad records Tom's first song on his phone.
爸爸用手机录下了 Tom 唱的第一首歌。

words.scene: Dad lying comfortably on a green sofa, eyes closed, holding a book, looking peaceful and tired after work.
A teacher standing at a whiteboard, looking kindly at Lily who is raising her hand to speak again.
Mum placing a large steaming dish of pasta onto the dining table, smiling at the family.
A small campfire in the woods with thick grey smoke rising into the air, Lily and Tom watching from a safe distance.
more: Smoke comes out of the fire.
Please do not smoke in the house.

words.scene: A clear 'no smoking' symbol (a cigarette with a red line through it) on a wall near a park bench.
Lily and Tom sitting in cinema seats, the screen lighting up brightly as the movie begins.
A clean bedroom with books lined up on the shelf, clothes folded in a box, and the bed made neatly.
Tom kneeling on the floor putting toy cars into a red storage box, looking a bit reluctant but trying hard.
Tom standing at a sink with soap suds on his hands, rubbing them together under running water.
Dad standing at the kitchen sink, scrubbing a plate with a yellow sponge, bubbles in the water.
A blue car stopped on the side of a road with its hood open, Dad looking under it while Mum waits nearby.
more: My bike broke down on the way to school.
我的自行车在上学路上坏了。

words.en: Look at the stars in the sky.
words.scene: Lily and Tom sitting on grass at night, looking up at a bright moon and many stars.
Lily kneeling down to give water to the puppy Max in a garden.
Tom under a bed, reaching for a blue toy car, looking worried.
more: Max is looking for his ball.

words.en: Look out! The car is coming.
words.scene: Mum holding Tom's hand tightly on a pavement, stopping him from running into the road where a car is approaching.
more: Look out for Max in the garden!

words.en: I can see the sea from here.
words.scene: Lily standing on a hill looking at a blue sea in the distance, wind blowing her hair.
Tom sitting quietly with headphones on, eyes closed, smiling, listening to music.
more: I like to listen to birds.

words.scene: Tom sleeping peacefully in a single bed with blue sheets, moonlight coming through the window.
Bright morning sunlight hitting Lily's face in bed, her eyes just opening.
Lily stretching her arms wide in bed, morning light outside the window, looking fresh.
more: I wake up at eight o'clock.
Tom doesn't want to wake up.

words.scene: Lily and Mia waving to each other near a park gate, smiling happily.
Lily in the garden turning her head towards a little bird singing in a tree, music notes coming from the bird.
Tom putting on a blue winter coat, Mum helping him with the sleeves.
Lily reaching up to a wall switch, the room becoming dark and dim.
Tom pressing a button on a desk lamp, which glows with warm yellow light.
Lily sitting at a desk, writing on a piece of paper with a pencil, focused expression.
A teacher writing on a whiteboard, students in the foreground copying it into their notebooks.
more: I need to write this down.

words.sz: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？
words.scene: Lily holding up a drawing painted in bright red, yellow and blue, smiling proudly.
more: Mix blue and yellow to get a new colour.
把蓝色和黄色混在一起，就得到一种新颜色。

words.en: Tom cries when he is sad.
words.scene: Tom sitting on the floor with tears in his eyes, Mum kneeling down to hug him gently.
Lily and Mia wearing safety glasses, mixing liquids in clear beakers on a lab table, looking curious.
Sam pointing his finger clearly at a red door, looking eager to explain something.
